key_structures: Main Garbhagriha housing idols of Mahalaxmi, Harasiddhi (Mahakali), and Mahasaraswati
Two towering 50-foot Deepastambhas with 1000+ oil lamp brackets
special_features: Spectacular illumination of the colossal Deepastambhas during evening aarti and Navaratri
Dark vermillion-smeared sacred murti seated amidst Mahasaraswati and Mahalakshmi
Revered seat where legendary King Vikramaditya performed severe austerities and offered his head
renovation_history: Ancient shrine celebrated by Kalidasa; ruined in medieval invasions; fully restored with monumental lamp towers during Maratha Peshwa and Scindia era.
